items.description: Benjamin Netanyahu urges rivals to join Jewish coalition and shun Arab parties as neither bloc set for majority

items.description: Lee Jae Myung prioritises Seoul’s interests with its giant neighbour amid strained ties with Ukraine, analysts say

items.title: Bolsonaro lands in US after fleeing Brazil following election defeat
items.description: Rightwing politician and son of jailed ex-president Jair Bolsonaro arrived in Florida on Tuesday evening

items.description: Parliamentary inquiry says consumers are carrying ‘extraordinary’ financial risk and footing most of the £40bn bill as private investors ‘cash in’

items.title: Healey puts UK energy reform at centre of his ‘do no harm’ Budget
items.description: Chancellor to pledge extra support for businesses, entrepreneurs and households during ‘difficult moment’

items.title: Healey to reverse cuts to cash Isa allowance
items.description: Chancellor will use Wednesday’s Budget to maintain tax-free limit at £20,000 a year, reversing plan by predecessor Rachel Reeves

items.title: Judge Limits Candace Owens’s Liability in Macron Defamation Case
items.description: The French president, Emmanuel Macron, and his wife, Brigitte, sued Candace Owens in 2025 over claims she made about Ms. Macron’s gender. A judge said the court had jurisdiction over her companies but not her.

items.title: Bots Drive Online Chatter About Races in Kansas and Texas
items.description: Much of the online discourse about Senate races in Texas and Kansas is coming from accounts that appear to be automated, according to new research.

items.title: GM Is Leaving NYSE for the Nasdaq After More Than 100 Years
items.description: After more than 100 years on the New York Stock Exchange, the automaker is shifting its listing to the Nasdaq, which is home to many technology companies.

items.title: In Anthropic I.P.O., Goldman and Morgan Stanley Slug It Out for Top Bank
items.description: Anthropic named the Wall Street firms lead underwriters on its upcoming public offering, a role that will generate generous fees and enormous prestige.

items.title: The Fed Is Expected to Hold Rates Steady. Warsh Will Have to Explain Why.
items.description: Inflation is moving in the wrong direction and the labor market remains stable, a combination that bolsters the case for higher interest rates.

items.title: Why Is Halloween Candy So Expensive?
items.description: The average cost of a 100-piece bag has jumped 71 percent in the last five years. Consumers are thinking twice about what they’ll spend.
